items.text: Sharia law operates in this state (one of 12 northern states) and is increasingly enforced; it may be applied to non-Muslims. Adultery can bring harsh punishment, including corporal punishment and potentially the death penalty.
Same-sex relationships are illegal across Nigeria, including any public show of a same-sex relationship; same-sex sexual activity can carry severe penalties in Sharia law states.
Avoid public displays of affection and follow conservative dress codes.

affection-and-relationships.notes: Smartraveller is the second-choice source; the state's own Sharia penal code was not read.
